name: ZSF_FCST_AUTO_PILOT_JOB_DEFN
description: A list of managed jobs that should be scheduled by Autopilot Job shall be maintained in table ZSF_FCST_AUTO_PILOT_JOB_DEFN. Data for this table shall be inserted using SQL script during upgrade.

columns.name: MANAGED_JOB_CODE
columns.description: Primary Key. Name of the managed job to be scheduled by autopilot.

columns.name: ESS_JOB_PACKAGE
columns.description: Package within which the ESS job has been defined in the CrmEss application

columns.name: ESS_JOB_NAME
columns.description: Job Name as defined in the CrmEss application.

columns.name: FREQUENCY
columns.description: MINUTE / HOUR / DAY / WEEK / MONTH / YEAR / FCST_HEADER_FREEZE_DATE

columns.name: FREQUENCY_INTERVAL
columns.description: Frequency Interval. Eg., HOUR with 2 will mean once every 2 hours.

columns.name: RETRY_COUNT
columns.description: Number of times the Autopilot Job should retry execution of this job if it results in an ERROR before giving up.

columns.name: REFERENCE_DATE_TIME
columns.description: For Hourly jobs, the earliest MINUTE is used. For Daily jobs, only HH is used. For WEEKLY jobs, the WEEKDAY+HH is used. For MONTHLY jobs, the DAY+HH is used. For Yearly jobs, the DAY+MONTH+HH is used. For FCST_HEADER_FREEZE_DATE based jobs, only HH is used.

columns.name: NOTIFY
columns.description: One or more of ERROR/WARNING/SUCCESS (For ex., ERROR+WARNING)

columns.name: PRIORITY
columns.description: 1 to 99. 1 is the highest and 99 is the lowest.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).
